title: fix(lint): warn on a stdio MCP auth that reaches nothing and on a credential typed into transport.credentialEnv
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8NWPXiR9AzY9UmgJXftg6QH)_
Fixes #29607

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`connector-credential-literal` 提示规则新增两条警告。一条是 stdio 的 `mcp` 连接器声明了 `bearer` / `api-key` / `basic` 的 `auth` 却没写 `transport.credentialEnv`,凭据被解析后被丢掉;另一条是 `transport.credentialEnv` 里填的像密钥而不是环境变量名。
- 为什么改:作者声明的凭据静默无效,没人告诉作者(#29607 第 1 项,路线 A);`credentialEnv` 会在每次元数据读取时原样返回,误填的密钥会被读出(增补评论 6590066946 第 2 项)。
- 风险与回滚:只加警告,任何保存与启动都不被拒,接受集不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/lint/src/lint-connector-credential-literals.ts` 末尾两段新判断;`packages/lint/src/credential-literal.ts` 新函数 `isCredentialShapedName`(防误报的门槛);`rule-explanations.ts` 新段落。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/lint-connector-credential-literals.test.ts src/credential-literal.test.ts`,预期全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Route A of the card, plus item 2 of addendum 6590066946. Both are warnings on the existing `connector-credential-literal` advisory; no accept set moves, nothing is refused, and `packages/connectors/connector-mcp/src/mcp-provider.ts` is not touched.

- **Item 1, a stdio `auth` that reaches nothing** (`lint-connector-credential-literals.ts`). A `provider: 'mcp'` entry whose `providerConfig.transport.kind` is `'stdio'`, with a static `auth` (`bearer`, `api-key` or `basic`) and no `transport.credentialEnv`, draws one warning at `connectors[N].auth`. The message says the credential reaches nothing and names `transport.credentialEnv`. The hint gives the key to add, and says to drop `auth` when the server takes no credential, because an unresolved reference still degrades the instance. Not drawn: an entry that has `credentialEnv`; `auth: { type: 'none' }`; the grant-bearing kinds (`oauth2`, `app-credential`), which the provider already refuses loudly at boot on stdio; an http transport; and a provider other than `mcp`.
- **Item 2, a credential in `transport.credentialEnv`.** The existing predicate cannot judge this slot. `isCredentialShapedLiteral('credentialEnv', v)` is true for every non-blank `v`, because R1 reads the key and `credentialEnv` contains the segment `credential`. Judging the value as a name is no better: `GITHUB_TOKEN` draws too. So `credential-literal.ts`, the predicate's one home, gains a sibling, `isCredentialShapedName(value)`. It reuses the R2 auth-scheme pattern and the template pattern, and reads no name list. A value draws when it opens with an auth scheme (`Bearer …`), or when it has a run of 16 or more letters and digits that switches between the two at least four times, the way a generated token does. A conventional name never draws. That includes long capital names with no digits (`ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXY`), names with underscores, and names with one or two digit groups (`SERVICEACCOUNTTOKEN2`, `PROD2024REPOSITORYTOKEN`); the seat asked for those pins. The trade-off is that a token written in letters only does not draw. The finding sits at `connectors[N].providerConfig.transport.credentialEnv`, on any transport (the key is stored and served either way), and never echoes the value. The function is not on the package entry, so the public surface is byte-unchanged.
- `rule-explanations.ts`: one new paragraph in `os explain connector-credential-literal` for the two route findings.
- `.changeset/29607-stdio-auth-unplaced-advisory.md`: `@objectstack/lint` patch, both declaration lines.

## Why

The card's measurement and the order's hypothesis, reproduced on `origin/main` 3482f3d8:

- **Boot, through the automation service.** This was a scratch copy of the `declarative stdio instance through the automation service` harness in `mcp-stdio-credential-env.test.ts`, with `credentialEnv` removed, and it was deleted after the run. The resolver was asked for the reference (`asked= ["OS_TEST_MCP_STDIO_CREDENTIAL_REF"]`). The instance came up `state= ready` with no degraded reason, and the spawned child reported `unset:0`: the credential never reached it, and nothing said so. The provider-level control (`control: the same instance with no credentialEnv …`) passes the same way.
- **Lint, before.** `lintConnectorCredentialLiterals` returned `[]` for both shapes: a stdio `bearer` entry with no `credentialEnv`, and a `credentialEnv` holding a token-shaped value.
- **Count: 0.** No shipped template or example declares a static `auth` on a stdio `mcp` instance. I checked `examples/**`, the `create-objectstack` templates, `content/docs/**` and `skills/**` here, plus `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` and `objectstack-ai/docs.objectos.ai`. The one shipped stdio instance (`examples/app-showcase` `showcase_mcp_tools`) declares `auth: { type: 'none' }`, and the docs' stdio example carries `credentialEnv`. So route A breaks nothing and changes no current output. Option B would also have had no producer to migrate, but it stays a ruling's call, as the card says.

## Tests

- New pins in `lint-connector-credential-literals.test.ts`:
  - each static kind on stdio draws exactly one warning at `auth`, with the exact message;
  - controls for `credentialEnv` set, `none`, `oauth2`, `app-credential`, no `auth`, http and a non-`mcp` provider;
  - an env literal beside an unplaced `auth` draws both findings, once each;
  - `credentialEnv` holding a token run or a `Bearer …` value draws at that key, never echoes it, and draws on http too;
  - four correct names draw nothing;
  - one sentence each, at most 210 characters;
  - the runtime publish gate case for `connector`;
  - three new facts in the `os explain` entry.
- New pins in `credential-literal.test.ts`: why `isCredentialShapedLiteral` cannot answer this; 11 correct names that never draw; 5 values that draw; templates, blanks and non-strings draw nothing.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test && pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` under the lock on 9bb1b840: Test Files 192 passed (192), Tests 7924 passed (7924), `tsc --noEmit` and `check:test-typecheck` clean, VERDICT command-exit 0.

<details><summary>Ablations on 9bb1b840: tests import the rule from src, so no build leg; each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob with an empty git diff HEAD</summary>

- Delete `transport.credentialEnv === undefined &&` (the item 1 guard): 8 failed / 23 passed. The `credentialEnv`-set control and the correct-name pins go red.
- The item 1 condition forced false (anchor `transport.credentialEnv === undefined &&` → `false &&`): 6 failed / 25 passed. Every item 1 pin, and the runtime door case, goes red.
- `if (isCredentialShapedName(transport.credentialEnv))` → `if (false)`: 4 failed / 27 passed (the item 2 pins).
- `alternations(run) >= MIN_TOKEN_ALTERNATIONS` → `>= 0` (the false-positive floor): 7 failed / 86 passed. Every long-capital-name pin goes red in both files.
- The first attempt at the item 1 ablation was a no-op that the tool refused: its anchor was a substring of its replacement, so the count did not drop. It was redone with the anchor above.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- One rule id, deliberately. Both route findings ride `connector-credential-literal`, because they are about where that rule's steer sends the credential. They need no new registry row, door wiring or explain entry. `authoring-rules.ts` is untouched, and its row comment still reads "four header/env maps". That is now incomplete, but it is not false.
- `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx` ("A stdio transport that names no `credentialEnv` does not apply `auth`") is still true. It could add that the advisory now reports this. That is outside this PR's file surface.
- `skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md` recipe 6 still says "a `stdio` server's credentials ride `transport.env`". That predates `credentialEnv`, and it steers toward the literal the advisory warns on. `skills/**` is a governed surface, so this PR leaves it alone (carrier: none, noted for the seat).

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gates on 9bb1b840</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on 9bb1b840: 57 families, from 6 paths vs merge base 3482f3d8 (+318/-6). The runner ran each one once and captured its exit code before any pipe. 56 exited 0.
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exited 3 on the first round, because its pinned positive control `621a4876` was not in the shallow clone. After `git fetch origin 621a4876` it exited 0 (48 cases pass).
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: the workspace is not fully built). NOT MEASURED locally; CI runs it on a full build.
- `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciled: 57 derived, 56 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (dual-build, from its recorded exit 3), 0 UNRUN.
- `pnpm lint` (repo-wide eslint, `--no-inline-config`) on 9bb1b840 exited 0.
- The branch is 4 commits behind `origin/main` e0187d0f. None of them touches `packages/lint`, `packages/connectors` or any derivation input (the `--ran` banner says the same), so I did not merge main.
- The lint package's dependency closure plus `@objectstack/connector-mcp`'s were built under the lock (VERDICT command-exit 0) before the tests and the reproduction ran.

</details>

- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
